prefix: LE <4sHHII>: IKFI, version1, reserved0, metadataBytes, helperBytes
signedMessage: ASCII InkTag factory-init followed by NUL, then complete prefix, canonical ASCII JSON metadata and helper bytes
trust: Same exact Goodix family trust pin and crypto primitive as ordinary signed App validation; independent purpose-separated signature, not App signature reuse
signatureEncoding: Goodix family encoding: RSA2048-PSS-SHA256 salt32 little-endian signature, or P256-SHA256 raw big-endian r32+s32

familyBase.selection: One shared App/Recovery; verify both exact-part envelopes, then select only the exact PCB MCU. No family alias supplies a capacity/package ID or relaxes actual-chip admission.

notes: Authenticates exact raw and signed App payload plus Recovery, helper and target/layout/compatibility/RAM mapping.
Editable PCB configuration must not replace any executable bytes, entry, RAM addresses or NVDS operations.
Private generation retains App ELF/PT_LOAD, SDK object, source/toolchain and helper ELF proof; the portable verifier does not require SDK or ELF.
Signature and memory validation do not independently prove ARM instruction semantics: the signed operation profile requires private-source review.
The old physical runner remains unchanged. Build-only manifests and this envelope do not enable portable execution. Private production signing is separate and does not qualify a device writer.
